description: Canonical first-pass concept IDs for the Federation knowledge graph.

concepts.label: Eternal Now
concepts.summary: Root principle of recursive becoming and living continuity.

concepts.label: Living Node
concepts.summary: Recursive base object for persons, trees, scrolls, repositories, bounties, tribes, cooperatives, and federation entities.

concepts.label: Tree of Life UX
concepts.summary: Visual interface where members begin as buds or flowers, mature into fruit, release seeds, and grow trees within local forests.

concepts.label: Fibonacci Growth
concepts.summary: Growth rhythm for layers, spacing, progression, learning, release cycles, and visual emergence.

concepts.label: Mandelbrot Recursion
concepts.summary: Self-similar structure where each branch can reveal another tree-like projection of the whole.

concepts.label: Toroidal Flow
concepts.summary: Circular flow of value, knowledge, consent, stewardship, and regeneration.

concepts.label: Consent Ledger
concepts.summary: Record of human consent, AI explanation, risk, action boundaries, and auditable decision trails.

concepts.label: Mysterion
concepts.summary: Federation-aware AI knowledge system and validator council architecture.

concepts.label: AI Gardener
concepts.summary: Bounded local AI role that helps members find branches, learning paths, bounties, and next actions.

concepts.label: Scroll Keeper
concepts.summary: Human or AI-assisted role that preserves, extends, validates, and implements Federation canon.

concepts.label: Proof of Learning
concepts.summary: Cultivation proof showing learning, comprehension, contribution, or validated skill progression.

concepts.label: Bounty Cultivation
concepts.summary: Bounties represented as seeds, flowers, fruit, harvests, and new seeds of work.

concepts.label: Biozoecurrency
concepts.summary: Living accounting of regenerative contribution and stewardship value.

concepts.label: DynastyLink
concepts.summary: Trust identity, lineage, and federated local profile path.

concepts.label: FractalCoin
concepts.summary: Toroidal economics and fractal tokenomics framework from Aetherion whitepaper material.

concepts.label: Local Tribe
concepts.summary: Local community, chapter, circle, cooperative, or branch where a member is rooted geographically and relationally.

concepts.label: Federation Seed Map
concepts.summary: Geographic projection of where trees, tribes, seeds, bounties, and local actions are growing.
